scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,GATEWAY,VITE" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "node run_backend.js" "nodemon index.js" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3330,3000,8001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { if ($_.OwningProcess) { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Write-Host 'Ports 3330, 3000, and 8001 cleared.'"
